_doc: Nhóm đối chứng: 50 mục ngẫu nhiên đã xuất qua đường người viết hiện tại (nghĩa vi Wiktionary/Wikidata + câu người viết)

items.gloss: very careful about details and hard to please
ex: Some people are very finicky.
I know that Tom is finicky.

items.gloss: the ability to speak or write persuasively
ex: He never distinguished himself by his eloquence.
She never distinguished herself by her eloquence.

items.gloss: the origin or start of something
ex: The idea for the show had an unusual genesis.
The book represents the genesis of financial analysis and corporate finance.

items.gloss: the state of having a higher rank or position because of longer service
ex: After I accumulated five years of seniority, I was promoted.
It's an old-fashioned company, with parking spaces and other perks doled out on the basis of seniority.

items.gloss: the act of stealing something from someone
ex: Nairobi has a reputation for thievery.
This instance of thievery will not be overlooked.

items.gloss: a member of the clergy or a religious leader
ex: All other ecclesiastics were to contribute the twentieth part.
Besides Latin, Irish ecclesiastics developed a written form of Old Irish.

items.gloss: large, ancient fish prized for its meat and eggs, found in northern temperate waters
ex: Most of the bone found was from the lake sturgeon.
Sturgeons can live for over a hundred years and reach gigantic size.

items.gloss: an image made on skin using ink and a needle
ex: Would you like to see my tattoo?
When did you get your first tattoo?

items.gloss: the act of being saved from sin or evil
ex: Outside the Church there is no salvation.
There is no source of salvation but him.

items.gloss: to move the hand back and forth to greet or say goodbye
ex: I waved back at him.
I waved goodbye from across the room.

items.gloss: Having the shape of a rectangle, with four right angles.
ex: A football pitch is rectangular.
A soccer field is rectangular in shape.

items.gloss: a self‑written biography telling the story of one's own life
ex: I want to write my autobiography.
Tom started to write an autobiography.

items.gloss: having quick and sharp ability to understand things clearly
ex: Tom was an astute businessman who made a lot of money.
An astute tenant always reads the small print in a lease.

items.gloss: the outside part or surface of something
ex: Others oil only the exterior.
There were some changes made to the exterior.

items.gloss: the act of improving something; progress
ex: Johnson promoted the arts in terms of social betterment, not artistic creativity.
Communities often adopt things that are for the betterment of the entire community.

items.gloss: a word part added to the end to change meaning
ex: I found a Turkish word formed by only three suffixes.
There are many situations in which this suffix might be used.

items.gloss: To negotiate new terms to replace old ones.
ex: Algeria could renegotiate gas prices with Spain.
The agreement was subsequently renegotiated, but details were not disclosed.

items.gloss: a violent person who commits crimes
ex: Tom called me a thug.
Everyone knows you're racist thugs.

items.gloss: a small cube with spots on its faces used for random numbers
ex: It's your turn to throw the dice.
Like many board games, the games use dice.

items.gloss: very fine in quality and comfortable
ex: The new theatre looks very luxurious.
Tom lives in a luxurious home.

items.gloss: dry cut stalks of grain used for animals, making baskets, or hats
ex: You need a lot of straw to stuff an elephant.
They filled them with straw to make them round and hard.

items.gloss: things that are no longer wanted or needed and are thrown away
ex: It's time to take the rubbish out.
The rubbish has to go out today.

items.gloss: a person who is very skilled at shooting accurately with a gun
ex: Police forces typically deploy such sharpshooters in hostage scenarios.
Sniper positions were also prepared at high points in the trench works for sharpshooters.

items.gloss: A melody added to another that keeps its own identity.
ex: The first species is note-against-note counterpoint.
This music makes heavy use of counterpoint.

items.gloss: too many to be counted
ex: Muscle tissue consists of innumerable cells.
I've tried innumerable times to contact Tom.

items.gloss: a decoration added to make something less plain
ex: The only grave goods were personal adornments.
One important factor is male adornments, or ornaments.

items.gloss: a soldier trained for quick destructive raids against enemy areas
ex: In the movie the bridge is destroyed by commandos.
The vast majority of the commandos were left behind on the island.

items.gloss: informal language that is not used in formal situations
ex: What's your favorite slang expression?
I'm not familiar with that slang.

items.gloss: the act of freeing someone or something from control or limits
ex: The divorce felt like a liberation.
At least tell us who we can thank for our liberation!

items.gloss: the seizure of an area to extract resources or exploit local labor for a distant country
ex: This has existed in Algeria since colonialism.
Many have long suffered oppression and hardship under colonialism.

items.gloss: to waste money or resources thoughtlessly
ex: He squandered all his money.
Tom quickly squandered his inheritance.

items.gloss: a bittersweet longing for things that happened in the past
ex: I'm feeling a weird sense of nostalgia.
Don't let yourself get carried away by nostalgia.

items.gloss: a piece of equipment used to broadcast radio or television signals
ex: There were three transmitters in operation at that time.
Very little work has been necessary on the transmitters.

items.gloss: a large hopping marsupial from Australia and New Guinea
ex: Did you see any kangaroos there?
Have you ever seen a kangaroo?

items.gloss: a scientist who studies how organisms interact with their environment
ex: Ecologists define two characteristics of every biological species.
Ecologists have used several slightly different definitions of alpha diversity.

items.gloss: a religious leader who leads worship for a community
ex: You're still a pastor, aren't you?
The pastor is in the church.

items.gloss: a small computer designed for one person to use at a time
items.vi: máy vi tính; máy tính cá nhân
ex: As the microcomputer industry grew, so did the language.
The engineer designed a custom microcomputer to control the laboratory equipment.

items.gloss: in a very careful way
ex: All rooms were kept scrupulously clean.
Scrupulously fair, with each clue presented openly and discussed.

items.gloss: a group of domestic animals kept together by people
ex: Carlos took great pride in the health of his herd.
Men tend to the herd while the women look after the home.

items.gloss: having a flat surface with no part higher than another
ex: This section of the road is level.
The house is on the most level part of the ground.

items.gloss: coming after the eighth and before the tenth in order
ex: You're on the ninth floor.
You're the ninth person to ask.

items.gloss: not exact; not completely accurate
ex: Note that Bell is often inexact.
Creative writing is a massive and inexact field.

items.gloss: a small tailless animal with long legs used for jumping that lives near water
ex: What do you know about frogs?
It's good to care about frogs.

items.gloss: to hurt, injure, or damage someone or something
ex: I could never harm you.
I don't want to harm you.

items.gloss: a fish with a flattened body that swims on one side, both eyes up
ex: Hybrids are well known in flatfishes.
Flatfishes have been cited as dramatic examples of evolutionary adaptation.

items.gloss: a person who unlawfully takes someone away
ex: What did your kidnapper look like?
The kidnappers have not been found.

items.gloss: the results or consequences that follow a disastrous event
ex: The aftermath caused another wave of strict media controls.
The aftermath of the war was felt for a long time.

items.gloss: a close friend
ex: From now on we're pals.
He's my old drinking pal.

items.gloss: legal membership of a nation, by birth, naturalisation or other means
ex: What is your parents' nationality?
Can you tell me your nationality?

items.gloss: The branch of medicine that studies the body's immune system.
ex: Collins is a professor of immunology.
Immunology is the study of the immune system.
